guide.title: Game Guide
guide.body: Browse without signing in. Playing requires a verified account. GIK credits are demo credits only and have no cash value.
guide.fpc: Fish–Prawn–Crab — symbol dice with Single Symbol and Special Pair bets

fpc.name: Fish–Prawn–Crab
fpc.description: Three-dice symbol game. Single Symbol x2, Special Pair x10.
fpc.guide: Choose one symbol (x2) or a special pair (x10).

highlow.name: High–Low Dice
highlow.description: Three dice; Low 3–10, High 11–18. Any triple loses. x2.
highlow.guide: Pick High or Low. Any triple loses.

plate.name: Spinning Plate
plate.description: Twelve-slot wheel with a fixed pointer; exact-match wins.
plate.guide: Select one of twelve slots. Exact land only.
